# agentic-documents

Write documents with people and agents in real time.

Keywords: documents, editor, rich-text, tiptap, yjs, collaboration, agents.

- SDK: import { AgenticDoc } from "agentic-documents".
- Read as Markdown, read an outline, edit by section id or exact text.
- Remote client: import { createClient } from "agentic-documents/client"; createClient({ baseUrl, token, fetch? }). It has one method per HTTP route. An error is a DocsApiError with a code and a status. Every call takes { signal }. The client never retries.
- Mount the app: import { mount } from "agentic-documents/ui"; mount(element, { baseUrl, getToken, documentId? }) renders the document list and the editor in your page and returns { update, unmount }. Load agentic-design/styles.css, agentic-documents/ui.css, and agentic-documents/app.css. React 19 is an optional peer dependency. mountEditor(element, { id, client, principal, room? }) embeds one editor. mountEditor(element, { id, principal, host: { doc, presence?, status?, onStatus? }, onEditor? }) binds the editor to a Y.Doc that your app keeps in its own room; the editor then does not load, save, or join a room.
- Web UI: the Worker serves it from dist/ui (a document list, a rich-text editor on the live room, rename, delete, share, presence, a mark on agent text). It ships in the npm package. Run npm run build in a clone, or point the assets directory of your wrangler config at node_modules/agentic-documents/dist/ui.
- CLI: npx agentic-documents <command> <id>. MCP: npx agentic-documents mcp --as <kind>:<name>.
- Sharing: grants, grant, revoke, invites, invite, link, unlink (CLI, MCP doc_<command>, HTTP, client). Only an owner may. Over HTTP every caller needs the docs:admin scope; in the CLI and MCP an agent needs it too. FORBIDDEN means you may not. Never grant yourself a role. A link token shows once.
- Every edit carries an author kind and name.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-documents
- License: MIT

- Review UI: import { ReviewPanel, CommentAnchor } from "agentic-documents/ui". Render with { doc: AgenticDoc, principal, writable: true, mode: "review" | "suggest", onAnchor? }. Use the editor host's same doc.ydoc; the host saves and syncs it. Default is read only. Both decisions require a different principal; agents also need docs:accept. Stale suggestions cannot be accepted. Machine authors are labeled. onAnchor reveals comment text in the host editor.
- Assistant proposals: import { createAssistantSuggestions, type AssistantProposal, type AssistantSuggestions } from "agentic-documents". createAssistantSuggestions(doc, machinePrincipal).propose({ target: { text, occurrence? } | { anchor }, replacement }) returns a pending suggestion id. target.at inserts; empty replacement deletes. The port has no edit or decision methods and no provider calls. Errors throw. Agents never accept or reject their own proposals.
- Browser hosts can import AgenticDoc, Anchor, Principal, createAssistantSuggestions, AssistantProposal, and AssistantSuggestions from agentic-documents/ui to avoid the root Node adapters.

Import ODT/DOCX with doc_import: id, format, encoding="base64", data (canonical base64; max 8 MiB decoded). Returns id and warnings. Export supports md, html, odt, and docx.
